findings.evidence: scripts/check-layering.sh:110 and :129 and scripts/check-readmes.sh:93 all use ^\[([A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+)\]$ and skip unmatched headers, against the fixed scripts/check-layering.sh:151-185 sections().
